name: search_records
description: Search Australian parliamentary speeches, official releases, bills, divisions and government grants (kind grant). Grant results carry a grant_recipient id to open with read_grant_recipient, or a grant_program id to open with read_grant_program. Returns record links and source excerpts.

name: read_record
description: Open an Opax public record using its slug from search results.

name: find_connections
description: Find organisations, programs, places or electorates in the audited connections dataset. Returns names and links; a matching phrase does not establish influence.

name: corpus_coverage
description: Read current searchable corpus coverage and source-enrichment statistics.

name: read_grant_recipient
description: Open a public grant recipient by jurisdiction and id from a search_records grant result (its grant_recipient field). Returns totals, agencies, programs and individual grants, with grants.gov.au source links where available. program_lookup provides program IDs matched by label; candidates are not proof of grant membership. grants_total, grants_listed and truncated describe listing coverage; field_guide explains compact fields.

name: read_grant_program
description: Open a public grant program by jurisdiction and id from search_records.grant_program or read_grant_recipient.program_lookup candidates. Also accepts a catalog file key or unique exact program label. Returns totals, agencies, selection processes, seat and margin splits, election timing, top recipients, electorates and individual grants with source links where available. Large responses shorten the grant list to at most 200 rows and set truncated: true; field_guide explains compact fields.

name: electorates_rank
description: Rank, filter or look up current federal or state electorate demographics from the published 2021 Census (ABS), including income, unemployment and median age. Figures cite electorate pages; all cutoff ties are included and missing profiles are explicitly excluded.

indicator.description: median_income is personal AUD/week; household income is a separate indicator.

operation.description: Defaults to lookup when electorate is supplied, otherwise rank.

jurisdiction.description: Defaults to federal. vic means Victorian state seats.

chamber.description: Defaults to representatives for federal seats.

state.description: Geographic state: federal + state=vic selects federal seats in Victoria.

electorate.description: Exact published electorate name, slug or ID. Letters, numbers, spaces, dots, apostrophes, parentheses, underscores and hyphens only. Required for lookup.

order.description: asc for lowest/youngest (default), desc for highest/oldest/most.

max.description: Inclusive maximum value; must be at least min.

limit.description: Defaults to 1; includes every tie at the cutoff.

name: find_records
description: Discover which OPAX register holds a name or subject: people, parties, donors and disclosed receipts, grants, contracts, suppliers, agencies, federal bills, declared interests, parliamentary pay, expenses, lobbying access, reports and audit reports. Returns up to 8 typed hits. Federal bill hits include introduction, recorded stages, passage, royal assent, Act number and sponsor where recorded; answer date questions with the date first. Use legislation for ACT/Tasmania bills and federal instruments, public_finances for budget and state register cells, entity_profile for profile detail, and corpus_records for Hansard speeches, statements and committee passages. Use access_registers for filtered ministerial diaries, lobbyists and FITS, member_divisions for member voting history, sponsored_bills for a member's sponsorship list and count, annual_reports for Commonwealth entity annual report pay, staffing and spend, integrity_reports for integrity commission reports, and royal_commissions for royal commission reports, recommendations and their published status. Use the dedicated complete count for those totals.

query.description: Names or subject words, e.g. "Thales Australia" or "Defence secretary pay".

kind.description: Optional: only this kind of record.

jurisdiction.description: Only records from this government or parliament.

name: parliamentary_pay
description: Dated salaries of federal MPs, senators and ministers (since 7 December 1999); pass as_of (year/date) or since/until for historical questions: a person's salary and post, what an office (Prime Minister, Treasurer, Speaker...) pays, or the highest-paid parliamentarians. Also current Tribunal rates (total remuneration, FRL clause) for departmental secretaries, agency heads and statutory offices: pass office, e.g. "Secretary of the Department of Finance" or "agency heads". Reported actual pay: annual_reports.

people.description: Named people in a comparison; include every requested person.

office.description: An office or post, e.g. "Prime Minister", "Cabinet Minister", "Secretary of the Department of Defence".

as_of.description: Calendar year or ISO date. Pass the requested year to select its dated figures.

limit.description: Rows for a ranking or an office's holders (default 5).

examples.office: Secretary of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade

name: member_expenses
description: Federal member or senator parliamentary expenses reported by IPEA for a calendar year or Australian financial year. Always pass the requested year, e.g. 2025 or "2024-25", or exact January to December / July to June since and until dates. Returns that year’s reported expenditure, including adjustments, with complete or partial reporting-quarter coverage. Uses the requested reporting year and expense measure. Includes former members where held.

person.description: Federal parliamentarian’s name; resolve spelling with find_people when needed.

year.description: Calendar year (2025) or Australian financial year ("2024-25" or "2024-2025").

since.description: First day of a calendar or financial year; use with until.

until.description: Last day of the same calendar or financial year; use with since.

name: contracts
description: Commonwealth government contracts (AusTender): who got a contract and supplier totals. With agency: the agency's contract total and its largest suppliers by total contract value. To find which department gives a supplier the most contracts, pass the supplier in supplier and choose group_by: agency. Returns buying agencies ranked by value or count, with ties. With supplier alone: totals, buying agencies and largest contracts. With query: the largest contracts matching the words. Contract values as published, not payments.

agency.description: Buying agency, e.g. "Department of Defence" or "Defence".

query.description: Words in the contract title, description, supplier or agency.

group_by.description: For a supplier, agency returns the complete published buying-agency aggregates.

rank_by.description: Agency ranking basis, default value. Use count for the number of contracts.

name: grants
description: Government grants: complete published totals by recipient, program or financial year, or the largest individual grants. For "how much" or "total" pass operation: totals and recipient (full name or ID), program, or group_by: year. Totals use complete published aggregates, including awards omitted from detail lists. For totals, from_year/to_year are financial-year start years. Recipient totals also accept aggregation: total, financial_year: YYYY-YY or complete since/until financial-year boundaries. Largest-award lists retain their calendar-year filters. For a biggest single grant use operation: largest and query. Federal award values are not payments received; Queensland records are annual expenditure lines.

operation.description: totals: complete aggregates; largest: individual awards (default unless recipient, program or group_by is supplied).

recipient.description: Full published recipient name or ID for a complete total. Use recipient for a named recipient total.

program.description: Published program name or catalogue ID for a complete program total.

group_by.description: Dimension for totals. Default recipient, or program when program is supplied. year returns financial years.

query.description: Words in individual grant records. In totals mode, filters names in the selected recipient or program directory.

aggregation.description: Sum all published records for recipient, optionally by financial-year range. Requires recipient.

financial_year.description: One financial year, YYYY-YY, e.g. 2017-18. Recipient totals only.

since.description: Requested recipient total start. Only complete financial years, starting 1 July, are held; other dates return a limitation.

until.description: Requested recipient total end. Only complete financial years, ending 30 June, are held; other dates return a limitation.

state.description: Grants recorded against federal electorates in this state (wa = Western Australia).

jurisdiction.description: Grant source: federal (default for state or electorate filters) or Queensland government.

each.description: Largest mode only. recipient (default): largest matching grant per recipient; grant: every grant, including repeated recipients.

limit.description: Displayed rows (default 5). Totals are independent of this limit. Year breakdowns are chronological; rankings are largest first.

name: declared_interests
description: Public federal/Queensland interests registers. Filter person, category, chamber, since/until, ministers or declaration words. Dates are lodgement/alteration dates or the stated register date, not gift receipt dates. Published items may be previews. A declaration does not establish a conflict.

ministers.description: Only sitting federal ministers (including assistant ministers).

query.description: Words in the declaration, e.g. a company name.

limit.description: Maximum items for one person, otherwise members.

name: division
description: Look up a specific recorded federal or state division by exact date and chamber, title words, bill name/key or division_id. Use this for how a person or party voted in one division, its passed/defeated outcome, ayes/noes, party majorities and named floor crossers; use the division lookup for the single recorded vote. Returns full member lists with published party labels and source URLs. For outcomes, state the result and ayes/noes first. For who crossed the floor, use lookup and answer with the named members against their party majority, or state that none were recorded, retaining partial-list qualifications. Mention floor crossing only when asked. total is the number of matching divisions before row/byte limits, not the number or names of dissenters; a division outcome does not establish that the bill became law. operation floor_crossing counts member-votes against party majorities over date/since/until; party_agreement compares party and other_party over that period. Aggregates default to federal divisions unless a state chamber/jurisdiction is specified. Both aggregates use the published index, not a retrieved sample.

operation.description: policy_votes aggregates a named party across every matching topic-title division, including linked bills and motions. Pass party and title (core policy words), not a single member or bill.

chamber.description: Exact chamber, e.g. senate, representatives, nsw_lc, vic_la or qld_la.

jurisdiction.description: Lookup defaults to all published divisions; aggregates default to federal.

date.description: Exact division date, YYYY-MM-DD. Retain the exact day.

title.description: Words from the division title, without the question, member name, chamber or date.

bill.description: Bill name or published key. Uses the bill record's linked divisions.

person.description: Member name for a vote in the matching division, not a cross-division tally. Lookup only.

party.description: Published party label; for agreement, the first party.

limit.description: Maximum detailed divisions, default 1. Response byte limits can return fewer; total is before limits.

name: count_records
description: Exact counts of all published divisions or bills, filtered by jurisdiction, chamber and period. Use for any "how many", "number of", "more or fewer than", bill pass rate, division or bill trend question. Use the complete scoped index for counts. group_by year/month returns every period including zero counts. Bills use introduction date and originating chamber; status is the snapshot status of that introduction cohort, not the date a bill passed. term uses the bill parliament field. bill counts all divisions linked on that bill page. include_records lists the matching bill titles. Returns snapshot/build date, latest record date and coverage limits. State the number first, with the requested chamber and period. For exact speech counts use count_speeches, or speech_trend for periods; the bill page speech list is capped.

jurisdiction.description: Default federal; inferred from a named state chamber when omitted. Bills cover federal parliament only.

chamber.description: Bills: originating chamber. Divisions: chamber in which the vote occurred.

date.description: One calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD. Use one period selector, or since/until.

financial_year.description: Australian financial year, e.g. 2024-25 or 2024-2025, July to June.

term.description: Federal parliament ordinal. Bills use registry parliament. Divisions use first sitting boundaries, with dissolution bounds for the 46th/47th as in Ask. Current/last term: 48th/47th.

since.description: Inclusive start, YYYY-MM-DD. Since a year means YYYY-01-01.

until.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for counts through the published snapshot.

status.description: Bills only. negatived: defeated on its final recorded question; lapsed excludes those. Returns count, denominator and share_percent within the same cohort.

bill.description: Divisions only: exact published bill key or full title. Count the exact bill page links.

include_records.description: Bills only: include up to 50 matching bill titles/links; total always counts every matching record.

name: money_totals
description: Sum federal disclosed receipts for a party or donor, rank parties or donors by total, or show annual totals. Party totals use the full published party aggregates, not the selected donor flows. Use group_by=donor with party for its biggest receipt sources; group_by=party ranks recipient parties; group_by=year gives a chronological FY series. financial_year accepts 2017-18; from_year/to_year are inclusive FY starting years. With no period, use lifetime totals. measure=donations counts only AEC Donation Received in donor figures, for who gives, donates, funds or is a donor; other receipt types come back as separate labelled lines. measure=all_types (the default) counts every receipt type, for money from, receipts or paid: mixed disclosed receipts, not just gifts. Public funding is listed apart from donors. Party totals always cover all receipt types. State the total first with its financial year or range; each citation binds its amount to that period. For grants use grants; for expenses use the expenses tool.

party.description: Recipient party name, e.g. Labor, Liberal Party, Nationals, LNP or Country Liberal Party.

donor.description: Disclosed donor name, published alias or graph ID. Without party, totals across all recipient parties.

financial_year.description: One complete financial year, e.g. 2017-18 or 2017-2018.

from_year.description: First FY starting year, inclusive (2017 means 2017-18).

since.description: Optional first complete FY boundary, YYYY-07-01. Other boundaries return a coverage limitation.

until.description: Optional last complete FY boundary, YYYY-06-30. Other boundaries return a coverage limitation.

measure.description: Donor figures: donations (AEC Donation Received only) or all_types (default; every receipt type). Party totals always cover all receipt types.

lending.description: Set true for a question about loans, lending, borrowing or debts: the answer adds what the party's own returns declare as debts, beside the receipts.

group_by.description: Default: one total for a named party/donor, otherwise rank parties. industry sums every selected donor flow by its industry, excluding individuals, unclassified sources and associated entities of the recipient; use for which industries gave most. year returns every observed FY in chronological order.

limit.description: Maximum ranked entities, default 5. Year series retain all observed years.

name: campaign_spend
description: Recorded government campaign advertising costs. Pass the campaign name and financial year, optionally advertiser and jurisdiction. Prefer exact campaign names over longer partial matches. Returns the published amount for each named cost category with GST basis and campaign period. Keep each published cost category separate and report its recorded amount or availability.

name: corpus_records
description: Search Hansard speeches, official press releases/statements and committee-hearing turns by subject words, speaker, jurisdiction and inclusive since/until dates. kind=speech or press_release. venue=committee includes witnesses; attribute each passage to its explicit recorded speaker. Search excerpts are checked against the original source body, excluding machine summaries; named-member excerpts use only their first speaking turn. Follow record_id for up to 4,000 characters around query, or continue via next_text_offset. SA Hansard stays capped at 120 words per record and has no text paging. Each row has source_url, OPAX record URL and citation; missing original provenance is explicit. A ranked sample describes these matched excerpts; a claim of whole-period absence needs complete scoped evidence. Use existing speech-count tools for counts.

speaker.description: A named parliamentarian for speeches; exact source collaborator for releases.

party.description: Speech party on the day, e.g. Labor or Coalition. Does not infer release affiliation.

topic.description: Optional machine topic label, e.g. housing. Query words also search unlabelled text.

name: legislation
description: Search or open ACT and Tasmania state bills, or federal legislative instruments. State bills return sponsors, introduction, status as-of and, with record_id, published dated stages and original version/explanatory links. Instruments return Federal Register metadata, making/registration/commencement dates and bounded version details. Use kind, query words or record_id copied from a prior row. since/until filter bill introduction or instrument as-made registration dates. offset pages search results. Metadata only: held state bill bodies and instrument legal text are read at the original source. Federal bills remain in find_records(kind=bill).

name: public_finances
description: Search and open published federal budget aggregates and papers, historical SA budget cells, Treasury tax expenditures, ABS government finances and spending by function, government advertising (all row kinds), historical SA grants, and Victorian ministerial gifts (chamber and since/until filters apply only to these gifts). Choose dataset, then query words and optional financial_year, release or entity. Returns original units, source cells, dated snapshot and row citations. Follow a row with dataset + record_id for detail; use offset to page. For federal budget papers use view=documents. Measure-level federal budget lines are not exported. Nulls and suppression markers are not zero. Use each published non-overlapping measure with its release vintage and hierarchy level.

record_id.description: Copy from a row. Identifies a row in this export snapshot.

release.description: Exact publication vintage/release, separate from the measured financial year.

entity.description: Words in recipient, office holder, giver, advertiser or government jurisdiction.

view.description: Default rows; documents lists cleared federal budget source papers.

name: entity_profile
description: Find and open supplier, agency and audited connection profiles, or tax/charity records by ABN. Search with kind + query; copy record_id into a follow-up. section=contracts opens individual notices; receipts shows the supplier’s explicitly linked federal political receipt aggregates; grants joins by ABN to federal and Queensland awards; evidence opens audited mention excerpts; tax opens ATO/ACNC figures by ABN. offset pages each section. Join entities using published identity links or exact ABNs. source_scope distinguishes individual record links from dataset/register provenance. Listings can omit awards held in complete summaries; use grants for complete recipient totals. Tax payable is not tax paid, and charity donations received are not political donations.

name: access_registers
description: Query published ministerial diaries, registered lobbying clients/firms and the Foreign Influence Transparency Scheme (FITS). Choose register=meetings, lobbyists or fits. Filter minister, organisation, lobbyist, client, jurisdiction and dates; use offset for rows or record_id for detail. Meetings: who met a minister or which ministers met an organisation. Lobbyists: lobbyist is firm, client/organisation is its published client. FITS: organisation/lobbyist filters registrant, client filters foreign principal, minister filters a named registrant. Dates mean exported meeting date, earliest published lobbyist registration date, or overlap with the FITS registration interval. Some meeting dates are reporting-period starts. Lobbyist status is merged: current means active in at least one listed jurisdiction, not necessarily the selected state. access.json retains only eight rows per profile and often no original entry URL. counts.retained_matches is a sample count; exact_count is null unless completeness is established. published_totals describe all-time profiles; dated questions use explicitly dated rows. source_status distinguishes original entry provenance from OPAX projection evidence; a latest diary PDF is not a citation for an older meeting. Registration or a meeting does not establish influence or wrongdoing.

name: member_divisions
description: Read how a resolved member voted across the published federal or state divisions, with aye/no/explicit absent/paired counts and votes against an eligible published party majority. Filter date range, chamber, jurisdiction, topic title words or bill keyword/key. Each row has division_id and a follow_up for the division tool. Recent votes.json and the D1 votes table are samples, so this tool scans the authoritative division files instead. operation=list returns up to 8 rows; operation=count scans up to scan_limit divisions without listing rows. Counts cover the disjoint scanned segment. Follow next_call until next_cursor=null and combine segment counts from the same scan_id for a full selection. A complete count follows the final cursor. A missing member row is unrecorded, not absent. Dissent uses reconciled complete lists, a strict majority and at least five party aye/no votes; published labels may not reflect historical affiliation.

topic.description: Words in division title/question or linked bill titles, not machine topic labels.

bill.description: Bill title keyword or exact published federal bill key.

cursor.description: Copy next_cursor or next_call; bound to the member, filters, operation and index snapshot.

scan_limit.description: Maximum division files examined in one call, default 100.

name: sponsored_bills
description: List and count the federal bills attributed to a member as sponsor in the complete published bill index, rather than the six most recent growth-summary rows. Resolve person by the existing roster rules; sponsor IDs and printed names must agree using the site sponsor resolver. Filter introduction dates with since/until, title keywords with query, status or originating chamber. Counts cover all matching attributable index entries before pagination. Sponsor metadata is often missing for government bills: report the scope and completeness of sponsor metadata beside a matching count. Copy bill_id for full lifecycle detail; use division with bill=bill_id for linked votes. Sponsoring, speaking on a bill, passage, assent and commencement are distinct.

name: count_speeches
description: Count speeches exactly, optionally ranked by speaker or party. Use for "who speaks most", "which party mentions X most", "how many speeches". Returns counts from the record index, the method, and coverage notes that must be stated.

speaker.description: speaker name exactly as find_people returns it

party.description: party label, e.g. Labor, Liberal, Greens, Nationals, LNP, Independent, One Nation

venue.description: chamber speeches (default), committee-hearing turns, or both

name: speech_trend
description: Speech counts over time (by year, decade or federal term) with each period's share of topic-labelled speeches. Use for "is X debated more", "how has X changed".

speaker.description: speaker name exactly as find_people returns it

party.description: party label, e.g. Labor, Liberal, Greens, Nationals, LNP, Independent, One Nation

venue.description: chamber speeches (default), committee-hearing turns, or both

name: find_people
description: Resolve a politician name, including typos, surname-first order, titles and common nicknames, to the indexed name, party, parliaments and years. Returns confidence-ranked candidates and one clear match in people. Equal matches require the returned clarification question; no_match means no person by that name is recorded. Dated service is returned per chamber and seat. Use service.start and service.end for first elected, entered, left or years served; years are speech coverage only. Empty service means dates are unavailable.

name: member_votes
description: Compatibility alias: delegates person histories to member_divisions and party title lookups to division. Prefer those dedicated tools and follow their continuation metadata. Follow the final cursor for a complete scanned history. For a specific division, its outcome, ayes/noes, a member's actual vote, party majorities or rebels, use division with exact date/chamber/title or division_id. Use division aggregate operations for period floor-crossing and party agreement.

name: party_receipts
description: Donor breakdown of disclosed receipts to a federal party, or receipt totals by party for one source industry (e.g. gambling, mining). measure=donations (the default) ranks only AEC Donation Received, for who gives, donates, funds or is a donor; other receipt types come back as separate labelled lines (other_receipts), described as other receipts. measure=all_types ranks every receipt type with its breakdown, for money from, receipts or paid. Public funding is listed apart from donors. Use money_totals for a party or donor total, rankings by total, or annual receipt trends. Only complete financial years are supported; from_year/to_year are FY starting years. Names follow source disclosure spelling; uncertain identity matches have no profile link.

lending.description: Set true for a question about loans, lending, borrowing or debts: the answer adds what the party's own returns declare as debts, beside the receipts.

name: find_quotes
description: Compatibility alias for corpus_records with kind speech. Prefer corpus_records for original verified speech or release excerpts, detail and paging. A ranked sample of original excerpts; count with the complete speech-count tools.

speaker.description: speaker name exactly as find_people returns it

party.description: party label, e.g. Labor, Liberal, Greens, Nationals, LNP, Independent, One Nation

venue.description: chamber speeches (default), committee-hearing turns, or both

name: person_quotes
description: Read one parliamentarian's own verified Hansard excerpts about a subject, newest first within the retrieved sample, one per speech. Uses the shared original corpus reader and the member's first speaking turn. These are matched source excerpts; complete counts come from the speech-count tools. Use corpus_records with returned record_id to read more or search official releases.

name: search
description: Search verified original Hansard excerpts. Compatibility entry for corpus_records with kind speech; prefer corpus_records for speech and release search, original detail and paging. Use complete scoped counting tools for counts and whole-period absence. Ask adds its question scope and citation IDs around the same retrieval capability.

name: read_passage
description: Read an original source excerpt by the public speech or press record ID and optional text_offset returned by corpus_records. Prefer corpus_records for full filters. Ask can also recheck a citation id from the current question, which is request state rather than a public record identifier.

name: person_overview
description: Read a parliamentarian identity, sampled recent Hansard excerpts and attributable sponsored bills together. A public data overview, not an inferred position or a complete career history. For historical questions use dated corpus_records or member_divisions; for their words use person_quotes. Ask also has an answer-pack formatter for this data.

name: paid_answer
description: Calculate a complete federal pay answer, ranking or comparison: parliamentarians for the requested year/date, and current Tribunal rates for departmental secretaries and agency heads. Pass the full question. The calculator supplies every figure. Use parliamentary_pay for individual dated office or member rows.

examples.question: What is the federal parliamentary base salary in 2025?

name: ranked_money
description: Calculate rankings of individual published money records, state disclosure comparisons or public money overviews from a full question. Preserves donor identity gates and financial-year semantics. Federal mixed receipts are not donation or influence evidence. Use money_totals for summed receipts and contracts or grants for individual awards. No generation or writes.

examples.question: Which federal parties have the largest disclosed receipt totals in 2024-25?

name: annual_reports
description: Commonwealth entity and company annual report disclosures from the Transparency Portal (Department of Finance): key management personnel and remuneration bands from 2018-19 reports, organisations paid from 2020-21, headline figures from 2022-23. Covers key management personnel remuneration by name and position (base salary, bonuses, super, long service leave, termination, total), senior executive and other highly paid staff remuneration bands, staff headcounts, reportable consultancy and non-consultancy contract spend (with the organisations paid, by ABN), and departmental total expenses. view=remuneration finds named people (filter body, person, position, year, min_total); view=bands lists bands for a body; view=profile gives one body's headline figures by year; view=compare ranks bodies by a metric in one year; view=suppliers lists organisations paid (filter organisation, abn, body); view=kmp_counts ranks bodies by how many key management personnel rows each published in one year (for "which agencies reported the most key management personnel"; counts are published disclosure rows, not distinct people); view=top_by_year gives one body's largest key management personnel total remuneration row in each year, oldest first (for "how has the highest paid executive's pay changed", optional position, first_year, last_year; each year retains its recorded person and total separately). Follow record_id from any row for its full detail. Amounts are as published: remuneration in dollars for the period each person held the role (part-year amounts are not annual salaries); spend and expenses in each row's stated unit (thousands of dollars, except 2020-21 supplier rows in dollars). Keep each body, table, band and year’s published measure separate.

body.description: Entity or company name or acronym, e.g. "Department of Finance", "CSIRO", "NBN Co".

person.description: Words in a key management person's published name.

position.description: Words in the published position title, e.g. "Secretary", "Chief Executive".

year.description: Reporting year. agency_heads ranks heads in the latest settled year by default, compare and kmp_counts likewise; remuneration searches all years.

first_year.description: top_by_year only: first reporting year to include.

last_year.description: top_by_year only: last reporting year to include.

name: integrity_reports
description: Australian anti-corruption and integrity commission reports (NSW, Vic, Qld, WA, SA, ACT; NACC, Tas, NT partly) and statements: findings or opinions in each commission's own words and labels, numbered recommendations and agency responses, cited to the report page. Views: reports, report (record_id, part), findings, recommendations, bodies (coverage, gaps), transcripts (hearing transcripts by body, operation, since/until; evidence, not findings). Allegations are not findings; a corrupt conduct finding is not a criminal conviction; statutory terms differ, so keep each commission’s findings and counts in its own statutory context.

query.description: Words in titles, or in finding or recommendation text.

subject.description: Body or public role named, e.g. "council".

name: royal_commissions
description: Royal commissions and similar public inquiries in every jurisdiction: establishment date, commissioners, report dates and links, recommendations in the commission's own words with the report page (numbered as the report numbers them), official implementation status where a government publishes one (Victoria's Family Violence tracker), government responses, hearing transcripts (evidence, not findings), and court rulings on parts of a report. view=list lists commissions (jurisdiction or name words); view=profile gives one commission's reports, responses, transcript count, court context and facts; view=transcripts pages one commission's transcripts newest first (words match title, date or text for Robodebt, Antisemitism, NSW Healthcare); view=recommendations searches recommendation text (words, number, status, report) in one commission or all. Status is unknown unless a government publishes it.

commission.description: Commission id from a row or words in its name, e.g. "family violence", "disability".

words.description: Words that must all appear (recommendation or transcript).

number.description: Recommendation number as the report numbers it, e.g. "12" or "4.1".

report.description: Report key from a profile row (for commissions with several reports).

status.description: Words in the published status, e.g. "Implemented".

name: agency_reports
description: Figures quoted, with their PDF page, from state and territory agency annual reports (mostly Vic and NSW; some Cth): agency head and executive pay, executive bands, staff, expenses, consultancies, and oversight counts. Views: coverage, documents, facts. Cth entity pay tables: annual_reports; integrity findings: integrity_reports.

name: member_profile
title: Member profile and electorate lookup
description: Who a parliamentarian is, or who represents a place. Give exactly one of: name (typos, nicknames and titles are resolved), slug (from an opax.com.au/subject/person/ address), electorate (seat name, federal or state) or postcode (Victorian state districts only). Returns party, chamber, seat and the OPAX profile link; an electorate or postcode returns the seat with its current representatives. Start here to get the exact name the other member tools expect: member_voting_record, member_interests, hansard_search and bill_search. An ambiguous name returns candidates to choose from rather than a guess.

name.description: A parliamentarian's name, e.g. "Penny Wong" or "Senator Wong".

electorate.description: Electorate name, e.g. "Grayndler", or its OPAX electorate slug.

postcode.description: Four-digit postcode. Victorian state districts only.

jurisdiction.description: With electorate: only seats of this parliament. Seat names repeat across parliaments.

detail.description: concise (default) keeps the answer short. full adds dated service periods and ready-made follow-up calls for a member.

name: money_receipts
title: Political receipts and donors
description: Money disclosed to federal political parties in AEC returns. Total receipts for a party or from a donor, a party's largest sources (view=top_donors), where a donor's money went (view=top_recipients), year-by-year totals (view=by_year) or totals by industry (view=by_industry), for one financial year, a range or all years. These are disclosed receipts, not donations: they cover every receipt type (other receipts and subscriptions as well as gifts, and may include loans, which the returns do not separate). Call a figure a donation only with measure=donations_only, which counts receipts the AEC types as Donation Received. Each item carries a statement with its amount, period and scope: repeat the figure with that scope and its label. Rankings cover OPAX's published donor selection (the largest donors), not every disclosed donor. A receipt is not a payment to a politician and does not establish influence. Names are as disclosed, including qualifiers such as "- Loan". For grants use grants; for contracts use contracts.
